facts: The use of a labeled directed graph to represent various types of linguistic structures is advocated.
A labeled directed graph can represent various types of linguistic structures.
NLP tasks can be viewed as graph transformations.
The use of a labeled directed graph enables viewing NLP tasks as graph transformations.
A general method for learning transformations is presented.
The transformations are learned from an annotated corpus.
Experiments are described with applications of the method.
One application is identification of non-local depenencies.
Identification of non-local depenencies uses Penn Treebank data.
Another application is semantic role labeling.
Semantic role labeling uses Proposition Bank data.
The linguistic structures are of various types.
The graph used for representation is directed.
